answer: Register each agent with its funding wallet on-chain; the registry clusters identities by funder, like cars sharing one bridge toll account. The first identity burns 0.01 token, the second 0.02, the third 0.04, doubling each time, so 10 identities from one wallet cost 10.23 tokens and 20 cost 10,485.75. Any cluster above 5 identities carries a violet flag and freezes until a human reviewer clears it. Unverifiable funding means no registration at all. Like a lotus rooted in one pond, each identity must prove a single, costly origin before it can bloom into voting weight.
